drawsToday.method: Deterministic portfolio diversification: distinct combinations, low overlap, balanced odd/even and low/high distribution. These constraints do not increase the probability of any individual combination; they reduce redundancy inside the research portfolio.
Deterministic diversified research combination. No claimed predictive edge.

truthRules: No combination is described as more likely to win until out-of-sample evidence demonstrates a statistically credible edge.
The 5 EUR envelope is a research/entertainment scenario, not a profit forecast.
Real treasury remains unchanged until the user explicitly confirms a ticket was actually purchased.
All future performance must be scored against official SELAE results and a reproducible random baseline.
